title: SSC authority boundary: qualified deployments for releases, loose source levels for intake
summary: Current Semantic Source Store is the preferred production dependency authority through immutable QUALIFIED module deployments and exact ssc_deployment_dependency rows. Deployment consumes sealedDependencies()/getDeploymentPackage() and never floats a sealed release. The earlier SSC_MANIFEST/sourceLevel/@source-requires model remains a loose development/archive intake bridge.
invariants: A QUALIFIED SSC module deployment is an immutable semantic fixed point for release deployment.
Sealed deployments retain exact dependency deployment ids; Deployment must not float them to newer qualified providers.
SemanticSourceModuleService~sealedDependencies() and SemanticSourcePackageService~getDeploymentPackage() are the current repository service boundary consumed by Deployment.
A sealed package must use resolution policy sealed-deployment-exact-closure and every returned semantic object must belong to the exact sealed closure.
SSC_MANIFEST/sourceLevel/@source-requires AT_LEAST remains development/archive evidence for components not yet represented as qualified SSC deployments.
::requires remains package-load evidence and does not itself identify an acceptable module deployment.
SSC owns semantic fixed points; Deployment owns target namespace, placement, activation and verification.

provenance.claim: Defines qualified SSC deployment authority and current service boundary.
Current SSC module service exposes QUALIFIED deployments, sealedDependencies() and exact deployment dependency records.
Current SSC package service reconstructs sealed deployment exact closure without floating dependencies.
Documents source.get_package development semantics versus source.get_deployment_package sealed semantics.
